name: A compound from its structure: methylcyclohexane by Joback
description: Methylcyclohexane defined only by its SMILES (CC1CCCCC1): Flowstead splits it into Joback groups (one -CH3, five ring -CH2-, one ring >CH-) and the engine estimates its boiling point, critical constants and ideal-gas heat capacity. Stream 1 is the pure compound at its bubble point at 1 atm (Joback's Tb, 379.3 K; the measured one is 374.1 K); stream 2 is an equimolar mixture with toluene half vaporised at 1 atm, between the two boiling points. Open Fluid package → Compound and data tools to build your own. PR.
